# Backend Engineer (Go) - Acme Payments

Acme Payments is a 40-person company building payment infrastructure for online shops. We are
looking for a backend engineer to join the billing team.

## What you will do

- Design and maintain the REST APIs behind our invoicing product.
- Improve the reliability of our deployment pipeline.
- Work with product managers to turn customer needs into features.

## Requirements

- 3+ years of professional experience with Go
- Experience with PostgreSQL
- Experience running services on Kubernetes
- Comfortable working in English

## Nice to have

- Experience with Terraform
- Experience with event-driven systems (Kafka or similar)

## We offer

Hybrid work in Barcelona, 28 days of holiday, and a small team where you own what you build.
